name: Case law: Germany, Bundesgerichtshof
label: Germany case law (Bundesgerichtshof)
coverage: 113604 published decisions of the Bundesgerichtshof, one file and one commit each, dated the day decided; 527538 citations of federal law linked to germany-law (134291 inside its record).
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day decided. The record ends at the corpus snapshot named in REPRODUCE.md.

source.dataset: the CC0 "Corpus der Entscheidungen des Bundesgerichtshofs" (CE-BGH, Zenodo record 15153244, decisions from 2000) and "Entscheidungen des Bundesgerichtshofs in Strafsachen aus dem 20. Jahrhundert" (BGH-Strafsachen-20Jhd, Zenodo record 4540377, CC0, the criminal senates 1950-1999), both by Seán Fobbe
